description:
Welcome to the world of puzzle adventures! Today we're taking a dive to the animals of the sea!

This drag-and-drop puzzle game is extremely easy to use and has been designed with the utmost care for children of all ages.

The different levels of difficulty provide age-appropriate entertainment for all children.
name: Puzzle Adventures - Sea Animals
intro: Easy to use puzzles for ages two and up. Featuring funny and cute animal motifs with 30 unique puzzles. 100% frustration free and child-safe.
